name: saw_scaled_viper
description: Saw-scaled viper (Echis), coiled in its threat display (stacked C-shaped loops), seen slightly from above, facing right: small sandy-brown snake with pale dark-edged saddle blotches, a pale lateral zigzag, rough keeled scale strokes (hold up at 2.4), pear-shaped head raised at the front with a pale cross/arrow mark, vertical pupil, heavy brow scale. Anchor centre, ~410x210. Keep: head (+150,-60). SIL-safe outline.
